remarks: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled home updated from top to bottom, inside and out! The first floor offers a spacious living room filled with natural light, a formal dining room perfect for holiday gatherings, and a large kitchen with plenty of cabinetry and workspace for preparing your favorite meals. A convenient first-floor laundry area and full bathroom add everyday practicality, while the second story features three bedrooms and an additional full bathroom. The oversized primary bedroom offers incredible flexibility and could easily function as a private retreat, studio-style suite, hobby space, or spacious home office. The property is being subdivided from a larger parcel, with the final lot size expected to be approximately 0.50 to 0.75 acres.  Updated taxes will be determined once the subdivision is complete.  Offers are subject to the town's approval of the proposed subdivision.  Conveniently located between the Village of Cattaraugus and Little Valley, this move-in-ready home offers modern updates, comfortable living space, and a great rural setting with easy access to nearby amenities.
